Overview

Knysna is a city in Western Cape with a population of 76,000. A stunning lagoon-side town on the Garden Route, famous for its oysters, forests, and natural beauty. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6b growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 270 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively high. The population skews young, with a median age of 28.0.
